content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text resolves a collision involving the challenger's own footed covenant-origin chain by treating the sentence's own words as decisive, which is the situation K-C governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the sentence's own words state the source of what is in the womb", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse / that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires: one reading lets the single verse's own wording decide; the other requires weighing the challenger's footed chain against the link's chain and forbids verse-by-verse stating-verse resolution.", "why": "Because the judge acknowledges the challenger's covenant-origin analogy is footed but then treats Matthew 1:20's own words as decisive, it applies the retired stating-verse test rather than weighing chain against chain by footing."}
